title: GTA6 Pre-Orders: Majority Choose $100 Ultimate Edition
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick reveals most GTA6 pre-order players are opting for the $100 Ultimate Edition rather than the $80 standard tier.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Setting a New Precedent: The $100 Game Era?

For the past few years, the debate over rising video game prices has been one of the most polarizing topics in the gaming industry. As production budgets balloon and development cycles stretch across nearly a decade, publishers have been eager to test the limits of consumer willingness to pay. However, when it comes to *Grand Theft Auto VI*, standard economic hesitation seems to vanish entirely.

According to Strauss Zelnick, CEO of Rockstar Games' parent company Take-Two Interactive, a striking number of gamers who have already committed to pre-ordering GTA6 are bypassing the standard release in favor of the premium tiers. Despite the standard edition landing at a hefty $80 (£70), the majority of early adopters have opted directly for the $100 (£90) Ultimate Edition.

## Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick Confirms Player Preferences

While rumors once circulated that Rockstar might dare to set a baseline entry price of $100 or more for the standard game, Take-Two settled on an $80 benchmark for the core experience. Yet, in practice, the average revenue per pre-order has effectively reached triple digits anyway.

During a recent media discussion, Zelnick highlighted that players recognize the extraordinary value proposition that a mainline Rockstar title delivers. For a franchise that launches once a decade and commands hundreds—if not thousands—of gameplay hours, consumers perceive the higher tier not as an unnecessary surcharge, but as an essential investment in their day-one experience.

## What Makes the Ultimate Edition So Appealing?

Several factors explain why players are eagerly jumping straight to the $100 tier:

- **A Decade of Anticipation**: The 12-year gap since *Grand Theft Auto V* has created unprecedented pent-up demand.
- **Exclusive Day-One Content**: Premium editions historically grant early access to customized vehicles, rare weapons, unique character cosmetics, and bonus starting cash for the evolving multiplayer ecosystem.
- **Fear of Missing Out (FOMO)**: In an age dominated by online streaming and social engagement, dedicated fans want immediate access to everything the title has to offer from the opening minute.

## The Broader Impact on AAA Game Pricing

GTA6 is undeniably the most anticipated entertainment product of the generation. Its commercial performance serves as a bellwether for the entire interactive entertainment sector. When Take-Two successfully converts a massive portion of its player base into $100 digital package buyers, it sends a clear signal to rival publishers across the industry.

While smaller studios may struggle to justify higher prices, mega-franchises with bulletproof reputations possess the leverage to normalize tiered pricing structures well above the traditional $70 baseline. As release day approaches, all eyes will remain on how GTA6 resets the economic expectations of next-gen gaming.

## Editor's Take

The rush toward the $100 Ultimate Edition shows that quality remains king in the AAA gaming space. Gamers are willing to open their wallets when they trust the developer to deliver an unmatched, generation-defining experience. If Rockstar delivers on its promises, GTA6 won't just break sales records—it will fundamentally redefine consumer spending habits in gaming.
